title: release r17: corpus-mined synonym dictionary complete (95 groups, 156 golden queries)
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- Synonym dictionary completed by corpus mining: 712 hazards keywords/aliases + 173 law aliases, subsequence abbreviation detection, curated colloquial forms. Final dictionary: 95 groups (was 50), each calibrated against real searchText coverage.
- Golden suite regenerated through real search.js: 156 cases (84 synonym recall).
- r17 bundle: 628 hazards / 173 laws; all suites green (node 19 incl. golden replay, python 20+135, v4 regression 20/20).
